new_findings_iter1.issue: Δ3 budget for ask_back to first sentence + surface_past_wonder is ≤1800 ms (M2 Pro) but assumes the two run in parallel and the slower (ask_back) defines the bound. If ask_back stalls > Δ3 budget, SPEC.md §3.3 step 7 says 'append surface_past_wonder.connector_phrasing at next sentence boundary if relevant' — but if ask_back is stalling there is NO next sentence boundary. The orchestrator should either (a) emit surface_past_wonder result first as a standalone utterance, or (b) timeout-and-skip surface_past_wonder. Spec doesn't say.
